shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions escalate as US-Iran conflict intensifies, pushing oil prices higher and renewing inflation fears, pressuring risk assets.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $69M net inflows, extending a seven-day streak, though BTC price remains near $65K.
Multiple projects in the Ethereum ecosystem suffered nearly $35M in exploits, raising security concerns.
The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act nears a Senate vote, with agreements on ethics despite disputes on enforcement.
A new report highlights the U.S. crypto industry's projected $55 billion economic contribution in 2026.
